goal: Replace the Phase166 blanket-unverified state for the 22 records added in Phase132-143 with current official satellite-provider eligibility scoped by exact Device Passport record, purchase source, release state and service path.
key_results: 22/22 newer Device Passport records receive an explicit Phase167 satellite mapping.
Google Pixel hardware eligibility remains separate from Japan service availability.
Apple-native satellite remains separate from carrier satellite.
docomo exact-device state is now usable by the diagnosis instead of always returning generic verification.
SoftBank Free Style exclusion remains explicit.
Open-market/SIM-free support is not inferred from carrier-sold variants.
iPhone Duo remains future/scheduled and is not promoted to current availability.
Galaxy S26 SM-S942Q is KDDI IOT-listed but its feature level remains unknown because the current official table render is ambiguous.
next_step: Phase168: extend exact provider eligibility beyond the 22 new records to currently high-value existing Device Passport models, then prioritize safe non-emergency real-device captures for Apple native and carrier Starlink paths.
